mandatory_rules.rule: Static V9 HTML (src/ + dist/) is primary layout authority for all V9-backed pages
Use direct section-stack parity; semantic reconstruction forbidden unless explicitly ADAPTED and justified
Every repair task must publish static-to-WP section map before any code change
No PASS on visual/layout tasks without static-vs-WP screenshots for each required route
DOM class probes are diagnostic only; never sufficient for layout PASS
No extra blocks on WP page unless listed DEMO or OPERATOR_APPROVED
No missing V9 blocks unless listed DEFERRED with operator sign-off
Content classification required: EXACT_V9 | DEMO | OPERATOR_REAL_CONTENT | DEFERRED — no mixed mutated text
OLD_PRE_V9 partials are HIGH RISK; must not ship on V9-backed routes without audit
Every repair updates final content/demo inventory JSON + architecture doc
